scenarios.name: create 1000 files
scenarios.command: for i in $(seq 1 1000); do echo $i > f$i; done

scenarios.name: stat 1000 files
scenarios.command:
for i in $(seq 1 1000); do echo $i > f$i; done
  for i in $(seq 1 1000); do stat f$i; done

scenarios.name: rm 1000 files
scenarios.command:
for i in $(seq 1 1000); do echo $i > f$i; done
  rm f*

scenarios.name: mkdir tree (10x10x10)
scenarios.command:
for a in $(seq 1 10); do
    for b in $(seq 1 10); do
      mkdir -p $a/$b
      for c in $(seq 1 10); do touch $a/$b/$c; done
    done
  done

scenarios.name: find tree
scenarios.command:
for a in $(seq 1 10); do
    for b in $(seq 1 10); do
      mkdir -p $a/$b
      for c in $(seq 1 10); do touch $a/$b/$c; done
    done
  done
  find . -type f | wc -l

scenarios.name: write 64 MiB
scenarios.command: dd if=/dev/zero of=big bs=1M count=64 status=none

scenarios.name: copy 64 MiB
scenarios.command:
dd if=/dev/zero of=big bs=1M count=64 status=none
  cp big big2

scenarios.name: read 64 MiB
scenarios.command:
dd if=/dev/zero of=big bs=1M count=64 status=none
  cat big > /dev/null

scenarios.name: pure read 64 MiB
scenarios.prep: dd if=/dev/zero of=big bs=1M count=64 status=none

scenarios.name: pure copy 64 MiB
scenarios.prep: dd if=/dev/zero of=big bs=1M count=64 status=none

scenarios.name: overwrite 64 MiB
scenarios.command: dd if=/dev/zero of=big bs=1M count=64 status=none conv=notrunc
scenarios.prep: dd if=/dev/zero of=big bs=1M count=64 status=none

scenarios.name: git init + commit 100 files
scenarios.command:
git init -q
    for i in $(seq 1 100); do echo $i > f$i; done
    git add -A
    git -c user.email=a@b -c user.name=a commit -qm init
